## 

Lost Kingdom: The Quest for Empire and the Making of the Russian Nation
Historian Serhii Plokhy examines 500 years of Russian imperialism, showing how leaders from Ivan the Terrible to Vladimir Putin exploited identity and warfare

## 

Lost Kingdom: The Quest for Empire and the Making of ...
An authoritative and masterful account of Russian nationalism, Lost Kingdom chronicles the story behind Russia's belligerent empire-building quest.

## 

Lost Kingdom: The Quest for Empire and the Making of the Russian ...
A singularly fascinating account of Russian nationalism through the ages." “Brisk and thoughtful, this book could hardly be more timely.” "In Lost Kingdom, Serhii Plokhy does for Russia what only great historians can do -- make the connections between the distant past and vital present feel relevant and alive.
